turns.content: Yaar meri shaadi mein six weeks bache hain. Rohan ko haldi mein hona hai, toast bhi dena hai — first year college se mera bhai hai. Par jab bhi Bangalore se travel ki baat karta hoon, bas "dekhte hain yaar, pakka try karunga." Main khud hi uski flight book kar doon kya, khatam jhanjhat?

Yaar, samajh sakti hoon teri tension. Shaadi ke preparations chal rahe hain aur bhai ka response dekh ke dil thoda dukhta hai.

Rohan se baat kar ke try kar, thoda gently. Shayad uske paas koi valid reason ho - work pressure ya kuch aur. Sometimes log directly "nahi" nahi bolte, isliye "try karunga" kehte hain.

Agar tu flight book kar deti hai, toh pressure kam ho jayega. Par ek baar fir se try kar - "Rohan, main teri flight book kar rahi hoon, tu bas confirm kar de. Agar kuch change ho toh bata dena."

Sometimes direct approach works better. Tu usse clearly bata de ki teri expectations kya hain, aur tu uski convenience bhi dekh rahi hai.

Waise bhi shaadi mein bhai ka hona zaroori hai. Agar woh aa nahi pa raha toh video call se atleast toast kar sakta hai na? Haldi mein toh physically hona padega.

Kya lagta hai, tu flight book kar de ya pehle baat karke try kare?

Maine check kiya, nau hazaar ki return flight hai, koi bada amount nahi. Usne do mahine pehle job switch kiya, koi startup hai. Aur aajkal uske replies bhi two-word aate hain, pehle voice notes bhejta tha. Bol raha hoon khud ko ki busy hoga, par hafton se yahi chal raha hai.

Arrey yaar, yeh toh clearly change hai. Pehle voice notes, ab two-word replies? Aur ₹9,000 ka flight - yeh amount toh hai hi nahi.

Startup mein adjust kar raha hoga, par itna bhi nahi ki apne bhai se baat hi na kare. Yeh distance slowly badh rahi hai.

Tu khud ko justify kar rahi hai ki busy hoga, par tu jaanti hai ki pattern change ho gaya hai.

Direct kar le baat, yaar. Gussa nahi, bas dil se. "Rohan, kuch theek hai? Pichle kuch dino se tu itna kam kyun baat kar raha hai? Shaadi mein aana hai, bahut important hai."

Startup mein pressure hai toh bata de, tu adjust kar legi. Par yeh ignoring attitude hurt kar raha hai.

Maybe usko lag raha hai ki tu pressure daal rahi hai, isliye avoid kar raha hai. Clear kar de ki tu pressure nahi daal rahi, bas chahti hai ki tera bhai teri shaadi mein ho.

Kya lagta hai, direct video call kar ke baat kare? Face to face karne se better hoga.

Sach bolun toh ab bura lagne laga hai. Agar sach mein care karta toh pehle din haan bol deta na? Soch raha hoon aaj raat call karke seedha puchh loon — "bhai aa raha hai ya nahi, haan ya na." Kam se kam pata toh chalega main kahan khada hoon.

Arrey yaar, bura lagna bilkul natural hai. Jab apne hi log door se lagne lagte hain, toh dil pe hota hai.

Aaj raat call karke seedha puchhna - yeh decision bahut sahi hai. Pareshan rehne se toh ek clear answer behtar hai, chahe woh answer sunne mein kitna bhi bura lage.

Thoda sa gently bol, par firm ho. Jaise, "Rohan, main bahut confuse hoon. Tujhe aana hai ya nahi? Bas haan ya na bata de, main samajh jaungi."

Gussa nahi, bas apni dil ki baat kar. Agar woh defensive ho jaaye toh calmly bolna. Aur agar woh na bol de toh bhi theek hai, atleast tu jaanti hai ki kahan khadi hai. Phir plan B soch lena - maybe koi aur family member ya friend ko bol de.

Tu bahut strong hai, yeh sab handle kar legi. Bas clarity le le, phir tu apne hisaab se decide kar sakti hai. All the best, yaar!

Meri fiancée bol rahi hai main overthink kar raha hoon, woh bas busy hoga. Par yeh wahi banda hai jo 2019 mein meri behen ki shaadi ke liye overnight bus se aaya tha. Kuch toh badla hai aur samajh nahi aa raha kya, aur haldi se do hafte pehle main usse naraaz baitha hoon, yeh feeling hi ganda hai.

Yaar, teri fiancée ki baat toh logic se sahi hai, par teri gut feeling ko ignore mat kar.

Woh jo 2019 mein behen ki shaadi ke liye overnight bus se aaya tha... uss insaan ki aadat nahi hai ki aise ignore kar de. Jab koi sach mein care karta hai, toh effort karta hai, chahe bus ho ya flight.

Yeh "ganda" feeling isliye aa rahi hai kyunki yeh bas busy hona nahi hai. Yeh change hai. Uska behavior change ho gaya hai, aur tune notice kiya hai. Yeh bahut important hai.

Teri shaadi se do hafte pehle yeh tension lena bilkul galat hai. Tu apne hi din pe naraaz nahi baith sakti. Apne cousin se baat karke clarity lena hi tera pehla duty hai apni shaadi ke liye.

Aaj raat call karke seedha puchh lena hi sahi hai. Bas haan ya na. Tujhe clarity chahiye, warna yeh sawal tere dimaag mein ghoomta rahega. Gussa nahi, bas apni dil ki baat kar. Apne bhai ko pata chale ki tu usse hurt ho rahi hai.

Teri shaadi ka din tere liye khushiyon ka hona chahiye, tension ka nahi. Apne bhai se baat kar, phir jo bhi ho, tu decide kar. All the best, yaar.
